answerCheck.reason: The zero dot product makes the line's direction perpendicular to the plane's normal. The line is therefore parallel to the plane or contained in it; containment is excluded.
A direction parallel to the plane is perpendicular to its normal, so d·n = 0. To conclude that the line is parallel to the plane, containment must also be excluded.

flags: Zero dot product alone also permits the line to lie in the plane. A complete parallelism proof must establish that the line is not contained in the plane.
